body: Hello, we can supply all 24 aneroid sphygmomanometers with stethoscope. We are still waiting for the new price list from the manufacturer and will send you our prices as soon as we have it.
Thanks for the request. The 100 adjustable arm slings are no problem and delivery would be 14 days. For the price please call our sales line and we will go through it with you.
Dear buyer, we have the 150 boxes of size L latex gloves ready. Prices are in the attached catalogue, please check the current list there and tell us how many you want.
We confirm availability of 200 boxes of 18G needles with delivery in 2 days. Our commercial team has to review the conditions for this volume and will come back to you with the price.
Hi, the black FFP2 masks are available and we can cover your 150 boxes. Pricing will follow in a separate email later today.
We can provide the 60 boxes of skin closure strips and deliver in 4 days. Prices depend on the order, so please phone us to agree them.
Good morning. No. 11 scalpels, 200 boxes: yes, we can supply them. You will find all our prices in the catalogue PDF attached to this message.
Regarding the 500 packs of 7.5 cm sterile gauze, we can ship within 7 days. The price needs to be reviewed by our manager first, and we will confirm it shortly.
Thank you for your enquiry. We have stock for the 80 bottles of liquid soap. We will forward the unit price in a follow-up message once the discount has been approved.
Yes, we can deliver the 24 boxes of 20 ml luer lock syringes in 5 days. Contact our office by telephone to get the price, as it changes with the quantity.
We can supply the 200 boxes of 12 Fr Foley catheters. Please see our latest catalogue, attached, for the prices that apply to your account.
The 500 pairs of compression stockings can be sent in 2 days. Our pricing for this quantity is under internal review and we will let you know the figure afterwards.
Offer for the 10 packs of triangular bandages: 4.88 USD per pack, delivery in 6 days. Prices are in US dollars, ex works.
Hello from our export desk. The 80 packs of soft toothbrushes cost 6.75 USD each (US dollars). Delivery 10 days after order.
We can supply 20 bottles of alcohol-free mouthwash 500 ml at USD 4.07 per bottle. Please note the price is in dollars. Delivery in 10 days.
Quotation: island dressings 5 x 7.2 cm, 150 boxes, 7.52 USD per box. Shipping time is 5 days. Payment in US dollars by bank transfer.
Dear customer, we offer the 300 packs of foil blankets at 5.87 GBP per pack (pounds sterling). Delivery to you in 7 days.
Thank you for your enquiry. 21G x 40 mm needles, 20 boxes available at 2.78 GBP per box. Delivery in 5 days. All prices in pounds.
We are pleased to quote 120 pairs of class I stockings, size M, at GBP 13.85 per pair, in British pounds. We deliver in 2 days.
Our offer is in Swiss francs: 10.29 CHF per box of 12 rolls of microporous tape, for the 150 boxes. Delivery within 4 days.
Hello, we can supply 20 elbow supports size L at 7.94 CHF each. Prices are in francs. Delivery takes 14 days.
Offer for 200 bags of gauze bandage rolls: 2.83 CHF per bag of 12, i.e. Swiss francs, delivered in 2 days.
We quote the 20 boxes of sterile latex surgical gloves size 7 at 326.26 SEK per box of 50 pairs (Swedish kronor). Delivery in 6 days.
Hej, price for the 150 boxes of 12 Fr Foley catheters is 173.03 SEK per box, in kronor. We can ship in 4 days.
